grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.candidate_exists: The current scan selected an observed attackable enemy.
predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: Ontology: Hero, Footman, Tower, Fort, Item, WaveEscort, WaveThreat. A WaveEscort is one retained living allied footman. A WaveThreat is an attackable enemy inside a 6-tile Euclidean disk around that escort (squared tile distance <= 36). enemy.near_escort affords attack; enemy.visible_but_far affords ignore-and-rejoin; no_escort affords regroup. Predicates are regions over observed integer tiles, not path reachability. Protected towers (standing, objectAlive=0) are not WaveThreats.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_wave_local.claim: R4 wave-following alone did not stop chasing: any visible enemy still pulled the hero off the lane. Restricting combat to enemies near the current escort may keep pressure on a lane and open the fort; it can also ignore a hero who is attacking us away from the wave. Untested on complete games.

B_wave_follow.claim: Using an observed allied footman as the no-target movement anchor did not demonstrate fort-win superiority (28/60 discovery vs baseline 30/60). That result measured nearest-enemy combat plus join-wave movement. It does not refute wave-local targeting.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_wave.preference: Keep productive presence on an allied wave. Prefer fighting what threatens that wave over chasing a distant visible hero. When nothing local is attackable, walk with the escort rather than to map center.

G_capacity.preference: Preserve baseline inventory use and ordered spending so this revision isolates targeting and movement.

G_base.preference: Keep decision accounting and attack/economy command contracts from the baseline family.

change.behavior: Replace nearest-enemy observation with wave-local targeting (6-tile escort disk). Join-wave movement and baseline economy unchanged.
